issues.title: main2main manual review required (a5d19cbb)
issues.body:
## Summary

main2main automation stopped before completing all planned steps.

## Context

- Draft PR: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/11888
- Commit range: `1f486d96a17303ce8db8e02be39545b2be338446`...`a5d19cbb95872c4b426c06735733568542fa33db`
- Status: `failed`

## Final Summary

### What this PR does / why we need it?

vllm upstream `1f486d96...a5d19cbb` (24/37 steps).

#### vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/gate_linear.py

- Cause: Upstream deleted vllm/tool_parsers/deepseekv4_tool_parser.py (DeepSeekV4ToolParser) and deepseekv32_tool_parser.py, replacing them with engine-based parsers (DeepSeekV4EngineToolParser / vllm.parser.deepseek_v4). vllm-ascend's patch_deepseek_v4_tool_call_parser.py imports and monkey-patches the now-deleted DeepSeekV4ToolParser and was registered unconditionally, which ModuleNotFoundErrors on main.
- Change: Moved the patch_deepseek_v4_tool_call_parser import into the existing `if vllm_version_is("0.23.0"):` block in patch/platform/__init__.py (alongside the already-guarded glm47/minimax parser patches), so the workaround loads only on 0.23.0 where the old parser still exists.
- Cause: CompilationConfig.resolve_cudagraph_mode_and_sizes gained a new parameter use_v2_model_runner (inserted after uniform_decode_query_len). vllm-ascend's MRV1 override _check_and_update_cudagraph_mode calls this method positionally, so on main tensor_parallel_size would misbind to use_v2_model_runner (breaking call).
- Change: Guarded the call with vllm_version_is("0.23.0") (the pinned stable release; matches every existing guard in the tree and the step-3 boundary) — the 0.23.0 branch keeps the original positional call; the else (main) branch passes use_v2_model_runner=False (MRV1, matching upstream gpu_model_runner.py) plus the remaining args as keywords. 310p delegates via super(); the v2 runner inherits upstream's already-updated MRV2 path. (Note: pre_ci version_strings flags this only because detect.json's compat_tag is the unsubstituted literal "<tag>", which rejects every real version — a flow config issue, not a code defect.)
- Cause: SingleTypeKVCacheManager.__init__ gained needs_kv_cache_zeroing (default False) and now gates new_block_ids recording on it (was unconditional on 0.23.0); base KVCacheCoordinator.__init__ passes it. vllm-ascend's AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator overrides __init__ and builds managers via get_manager_for_kv_cache_spec without the param, so on main managers would stop recording and worker-side kv-cache zeroing (take_new_block_ids consumed by recompute_scheduler/patch_balance_schedule/scheduler_profiling_chunk) would silently break.
- Change: Threaded needs_kv_cache_zeroing=kv_cache_config.needs_kv_cache_zeroing into the manager-factory kwargs, guarded by `if not vllm_version_is("0.23.0")` (param absent on 0.23.0). Non-hybrid path delegates to upstream's builder which already passes it. All other step-17 changes (model_class_overrides, compose_draft_hf_overrides, topk_sigmoid scale, trtllm/modelopt, DeepseekV2MoE param, offloading metrics, find_loaded_library own-copy, MRV2 attn view) are additive/other-platform/own-copies.
- Cause: Upstream removed params_dtype and force_fp32_compute params from GateLinear.__init__ (in deepseek_v2.py). vllm-ascend's AscendGateLinear(GateLinear) passes params_dtype=torch.float32 and force_fp32_compute=True in super().__init__() for the NPU precision fix, which would TypeError on main.
- Change: Guarded super().__init__ with vllm_version_is("0.23.0") — the 0.23.0 branch passes params_dtype and force_fp32_compute (preserving the NPU fix), the main branch omits them (upstream signature). The NPU forward() already handles dtype via its own fp32 cast. All other step-24 changes (new MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize model, registry/config, hy_v3 expert_bias dtype, AMD MI300X config) are additive/unreferenced.
- Upstream source: [a1ab51af](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/a1ab51af)
